summary: Maase Inc., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K to announce the board's appointment of Dr. Zhifeng Li as Chief Technology Officer, effective August 4, 2026. Dr. Li, previously chairman of a company subsidiary, receives no cash salary but was granted 12,500 restricted share units with a five-year vesting schedule per a standard employment agreement. The filing includes a press release and the form of employment agreement as exhibits. This is a routine managerial appointment, not a special situation; no strategic transactions, offers, or material corporate events are involved.
